SPTM 4800.attendance: Two points are deducted from the participation grade for every unexcused absence.
SPTM 4800.lateWork: Homework that is not complete and on time earns 0 of its 3 points; quizzes close five minutes before class, and a missed or failed quiz earns 0.
SPTM 4800.makeups: Students who miss classes, quizzes or assignments for religious observance get a fair chance to complete them, with a week's notice of the dates.
other: Interviews must be in person or by phone; email or text interviews without written approval cost 25% of the assignment grade.
Using AI to fabricate quotes, events or images is strictly prohibited and triggers an academic honesty investigation.
Grades are not negotiable; raise concerns by UGA email within seven days of receiving a grade.
No rounding up for assignments or the final grade.

objectives: Students will learn to gather and analyze information and data.
Students will learn to augment and overlay that with other background research and interviews.
Students will learn to conceptualize and produce sports investigative and other enterprise projects.
Depending upon the nature of the reporting projects chosen for the course, the students will study such topics as the business of sports, or medical or legal issues in sports.
Students will demonstrate competency in in-depth research and reporting, data analysis and visualization, long-form writing, and multimedia reporting and story presentation.
